top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Make sure that a working call system is available in each resident's  bathroom and bathing area.
Provide safe, appropriate pain management for a resident who requires such services.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that the facility has sufficient staff members who possess the  competencies and skills to meet the behavioral health needs of residents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Have posted "No-smoking" signs in areas where smoking is not permitted or ashtrays provided where smoking was allowed.
Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
To conduct inspection, testing and maintenance of fire doors by qualified individuals.
